output.reason: I find the brief convincing because several things fit together: the night staffing cut, the longer time pallets wait on the dock, write-off rates rising at night for every supplier, and Haverlow's trailer temperatures. It also sets out clear actions (restore night receiving, set and monitor a dock-to-chamber time limit, withdraw the chargeback), but the end of the brief reads a little muddled and it doesn't size how much of the rise Corriebank's claims explain.
